name: Ride Summary Report
query:
SELECT
    rb.name AS "Ride ID:Link/Ride Booking:200",
    rb.customer_name AS "Customer Name:Data:180",
    rb.assigned_driver AS "Driver:Link/Driverr:150",
    rb.distance AS "Distance (km):Float:120",
    rb.fare_amount AS "Fare:Currency:120",
    rb.status AS "Status:Data:120",
    rb.payment_status AS "Payment Status:Data:150"

FROM `tabRide Booking` rb

WHERE
    rb.docstatus < 2

    AND DATE(rb.booking_date) >= IFNULL(%(from_date)s, DATE(rb.booking_date))
    AND DATE(rb.booking_date) <= IFNULL(%(to_date)s, DATE(rb.booking_date))
    AND rb.assigned_driver = IFNULL(%(assigned_driver)s, rb.assigned_driver)
    AND rb.status = IFNULL(%(status)s, rb.status)

ORDER BY rb.booking_date DESC
